outstanding_rollover_adjustment.description: Outstanding rollovers / recharacterizations to add back. Non-zero values are not supported in this engine version.
outstanding_rollover_adjustment.title: Outstanding Rollover Adjustment

prior_prior_year_end_balance.description: Balance as of December 31 two years before the tax year; needed only to value a deferred first-year RMD.

prior_year_end_balance.description: Balance as of December 31 of the year before the tax year.

sole_primary_entire_year.description: Whether this beneficiary was the sole primary beneficiary for the entire distribution year.
sole_primary_entire_year.title: Sole Primary Entire Year

account_ref.description: Opaque reference from the personal workspace; no account numbers.
account_ref.title: Account Ref

liquid.description: Counts toward the cash buffer only when true (checking/savings, not retirement or illiquid assets).
liquid.title: Liquid

buffer_gap_amount.description: Positive when liquid cash is below the user's target buffer.
buffer_gap_amount.title: Buffer Gap Amount

essential_buffer_months.description: liquid_total / monthly_essential, 2 dp; null when essentials are zero.
essential_buffer_months.title: Essential Buffer Months

monthly_essential.description: Essential obligations normalised to a month plus essential variable spending (typical).
monthly_essential.title: Monthly Essential

extra_monthly_payment.description: Amount above the sum of stated minimums to direct at the strategy target each month. The engine derives the budget as minimums + extra so the web tier never sums money.
extra_monthly_payment.title: Extra Monthly Payment

liquid_cash.description: Total liquid cash. Alternatively supply cash_accounts and let the engine total the liquid ones (the web tier never sums money).
liquid_cash.title: Liquid Cash

monthly_debt_budget.description: Total amount available for all debt payments each month, including minimums. Comes from the user's margin, never from below the cash floor. Supply exactly one of monthly_debt_budget or extra_monthly_payment.
monthly_debt_budget.title: Monthly Debt Budget

difference.description: computed - imported, in USD, when comparable.
difference.title: Difference

first_rmd_satisfied_in_first_year.title: First Rmd Satisfied In First Year

refs.description: Input references (account_ref, obligation_ref, liability_ref...) the flag is about.
refs.title: Refs

months_to_target_at_contribution.description: ceil(remaining / monthly_contribution) when a contribution is stated and positive.
months_to_target_at_contribution.title: Months To Target At Contribution

vendor_label.description: Free-text label of the planning tool. Metadata only; not an integration.
vendor_label.title: Vendor Label

expected_amount.description: Expected per-payment amount for the outlook. If omitted the engine uses the typical (median) monthly amount scaled to the cadence.
expected_amount.title: Expected Amount

observed_monthly_amounts.description: Net amounts received per calendar month, oldest first. Used for the typical/low statistics.
observed_monthly_amounts.title: Observed Monthly Amounts

typical_monthly.description: Median of observed monthly totals across all streams.
typical_monthly.title: Typical Monthly

apr_percent.description: Annual percentage rate as a percent, e.g. '24.99'.
apr_percent.title: Apr Percent

extra_per_month.description: budget - total minimums at the start; never negative.
extra_per_month.title: Extra Per Month

buffer_target_months.description: User-chosen essential-expense buffer target. Optional; the engine never imposes a universal '3 months'.
buffer_target_months.title: Buffer Target Months

cash_floor.description: The user's own minimum liquid-cash floor. A hard constraint for recommendations, never a universal rule.
cash_floor.title: Cash Floor

essential_only_low.description: low income - essential (what is left if discretionary spending stopped)
essential_only_low.title: Essential Only Low

amount.description: Decimal string, e.g. '640000.00'. Never a float.
amount.title: Amount

liability_ref.description: Set when this obligation is the minimum payment of a liability in `liabilities`.
liability_ref.title: Liability Ref

points.description: Only days with events plus the horizon end, to keep payloads small.
points.title: Points

person_ref.description: Opaque reference from the frozen snapshot; no PII required.
person_ref.title: Person Ref

month_index.description: 1-based month counting from as_of_date in which the balance reaches zero.
month_index.title: Month Index

input_hash.description: Caller-side SHA-256 of the personal snapshot the request was built from.
input_hash.title: Input Hash

workspace_ref.description: Opaque workspace reference echoed into the receipt. Not an authority claim.
workspace_ref.title: Workspace Ref

result_status.description: COMPUTED is a descriptive baseline on the supplied inputs. It is not advice and not a verification of the inputs.
result_status.title: Result Status

request_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical request payload.
request_hash.title: Request Hash

run_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonical {request_hash, engine, rule set checksums, result}. Deterministic: identical inputs produce identical run hashes.
run_hash.title: Run Hash

coverage_status.description: Coverage-matrix status. SUPPORTED_VERIFIED means the published rule set has internal golden-test coverage; it is not an external attestation.
coverage_status.title: Coverage Status

result_status.description: Arithmetic outcome of the check. PASS is not a professional approval.
result_status.title: Result Status

unsupported_reasons.description: Populated when the check is UNSUPPORTED or INDETERMINATE.
unsupported_reasons.title: Unsupported Reasons

feasible.description: False when the budget cannot cover the sum of minimum payments or the horizon ends before payoff.
feasible.title: Feasible

first_year.description: First 12 months (or fewer) of the aggregate schedule for display.
first_year.title: First Year

interest_saved_vs_minimums.description: MINIMUMS_ONLY total interest minus this strategy's total interest, when both are finite.
interest_saved_vs_minimums.title: Interest Saved Vs Minimums

observed_monthly_amounts.description: Observed spend per calendar month, oldest first (transfers and refunds already excluded by the caller).
observed_monthly_amounts.title: Observed Monthly Amounts

info.description:
Deterministic, Decimal-safe financial engines with versioned rule/methodology
sets and traceable receipts.

* Assurance (B2B): lifetime RMD check for living owners of non-inherited
  traditional-family IRAs using the Uniform Lifetime Table.
* Personal (B2C, V5): descriptive cash-flow baseline and illustrative debt
  payoff path comparison on user-reported inputs. Descriptive arithmetic only;
  never advice, never a verification of the inputs.

Tenant context is supplied by the trusted web server via `X-SageSpan-Org-Id`;
request bodies never carry `org_id`. No client data is retained by this service.
info.title: SageSpan Calculation & Verification Service

post.description:
Independent RMD check for one account and tax year.

Returns PASS with the computed amount and obligation events, or a typed
NOT_REQUIRED / UNSUPPORTED / INDETERMINATE status with reasons. When an
imported plan value is supplied, includes a discrepancy classification.

422.description: Request did not match the contract (field paths only; submitted values are never echoed)

get.description: Versioned methodology sets used by the Personal engines (separate registry from regulatory rule sets).

post.description:
Personal cash-flow baseline: income statistics, commitments, margin, buffer, dated 30/60/90-day outlook, flags and data quality.

Descriptive arithmetic on user-reported inputs with a receipt citing
`personal.cashflow_baseline`. INSUFFICIENT_DATA is returned, not a guess,
when income, expenses or cash balances are absent.

post.description: Compare debt payoff orderings (minimums only, avalanche, snowball, hybrid) on identical inputs under a fixed monthly budget and the user's cash floor.
